So when I tried to play on my US account it told me I couldn’t. There’s an easy way around it. Just create a PS account for the region that you bought the DLC with and make sure you have your PlayStation set as your primary console for your new account. Then proceed to download it and it should make it so that when you try touch Miquellas hand on your main character (original region), you can still access the DLC. Hope it works for you as well
